description: HEC1 decode vectors for the opentine-1 grammar. Each vector decodes packs/<sha256>.hec with the want-set wants[want.ids] (exact set, or closure roots; ids as ASCII strings, or hex when not ASCII) under limits[limits] (Limits attribute -> value). expect is {"ok": true, "sha256": hex of the output serialization} or {"ok": false, "code": reason code}.
serialization: per decoded object: uv(len id) id uv(len descriptor) descriptor uv(len body) body; then uv(len aux) aux; sha256 of the concatenation (uv = unsigned LEB128)
